---
name: Improvement
about: Suggest an enhancement to an existing skill or propose a new one
title: "[improvement] <skill-name or new>: <short summary>"
labels: enhancement
---

## Use case

What are you trying to do? Describe the scenario before jumping to a solution — it helps evaluate whether the proposed change is the right fix.

## Current behaviour

If this targets an existing skill: what does it do today, and where does it fall short for your use case?

If this is a brand-new skill idea: what's currently missing — what do you have to do manually that a skill could automate?

## Proposed change

Concrete description of the improvement. For existing skills, point to the specific section of `SKILL.md` you'd change if you can. For new skills, sketch the trigger, inputs, outputs, and rough flow.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them. (Optional but helpful — it short-circuits a lot of back-and-forth.)

## Additional context

Examples, links to related skills, references to discussions, etc.
